_about: rival1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/rival1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

rv.on_the_chin.plant._orig: planting: the feet set wide with the front knee bent, the arms open a little forward and slightly below the shoulders, the palms open, the chin level and the eyes on the rival; he stands tall

rv.on_the_chin.lift._orig: the acknowledgement: the same stance, the chin lifted a few degrees, never thrown back

rv.on_the_chin.done._orig: done with it: the arms coming down and the shoulders rolling, the stance easing

rv.chin_beam.beam_in._orig: braced into the beam: the chest forward, the arms still open, the feet wide, the spine inside its range

rv.chin_beam.beam_out._orig: upright again with the plates smoking, the arms a little lower

rv.chin_beam.bravado._orig: the head turned to the rival for his one line, one arm still out and the other lowered

rv.hold.bfb_brace._orig: his own brace: both forearm plates drawn tight against his ribs, the lead shoulder rolled forward and the chin behind it, the spine upright, giving ground on his heels without folding

rv.hold.fin_walk._orig: the slow walk in: upright and unhurried, the hands open and low at his sides

rv.hold.fin_stop._orig: standing over the rival, looking down at him, the hands open and low, the weight settled

rv.hold.fin_held._orig: after the last blow: turned half away, the head turned, the striking arm lowered, done with him

rv.hold.hand_open_palm._orig: the open palm: flat with the fingers together, the arm out at chest height, the other hand open at his chest; never at the hip

rv.hold.hand_pinch._orig: the pinch: the thumb and forefinger drawn lightly together as the dart leaves, the elbow bent, no pointing finger

rv.hold.hand_clawed_palm._orig: the clawed palm: the fingers spread like tines, the wrist bent back, the arm out at chest height

rv.hold.hand_fist_glow._orig: the glowing fist: a closed fist held at chest height with the forearm plate lit along its edge (the light is VFX), the arm not fully out

rv.hold.hand_blade_hand._orig: the blade hand: a flat knife hand held edge on, the darts running off the edge, never a pointed finger

rv.hold.hand_crossed_forearms._note: in motion only: the moment the guards meet on the way to a blow; never a held pose
rv.hold.hand_crossed_forearms._orig: the forearm guards brought together plates outward for a moment on the way to a blow, the head tucked behind them

rv.hold.channel_charge._orig: the charge: one forearm high and one low, the plates facing each other across a body-length gap, the stance wide and low, nothing between the hands

rv.hold.channel_release._orig: the release: the arms torn apart, one up and back and one low and out ahead, the lance leaving along the line between them

rv.hold.kiting_turn._orig: already leaving: turned three-quarters away and looking back over the shoulder, one hand flicking a dart behind him, the other open at his side

rv.hold.rain_throw._orig: the upward throw: one arm thrown up and forward with the plates lit, the other hand low, the head back to follow the shot; never both hands overhead
